cards.name: Sad Hamster
cards.caption: *sad violin plays*
cards.flavor: 2023: a hamster with huge glossy eyes became the face of every tiny heartbreak.
cards.art: Round golden hamster with enormous watery sparkling eyes, tiny paws pressed together, a miniature violin floating beside it. Background: soft blue with raindrops. Colors: golden tan, white, pale blue, pink.

cards.name: Side-Eye Pug
cards.caption: Bombastic side eye
cards.flavor: 2023 TikTok audio: 'Bombastic side eye! Criminal offensive side eye!' Judging you.
cards.art: Fawn pug giving an extreme dramatic side-eye, one brow raised, lips pursed, arms crossed. Background: hot pink with dramatic speed lines. Colors: fawn, black, hot pink, white.

cards.name: Mewing Kitten
cards.caption: Can't talk. Mewing.
cards.flavor: 2024: kids went silent mid-sentence to show off a jawline. This kitten is committed.
cards.art: Gray kitten with an absurdly sharp chiseled jawline, one paw doing a 'shh' finger-to-lips gesture, confident half-closed eyes. Background: mint. Colors: gray, white, mint, black.

cards.name: Pedro Raccoon
cards.caption: Pedro pedro pedro
cards.flavor: 2024: a raccoon spinning in circles to an Italian dance remix, forever.
cards.art: Gray raccoon with a bandit mask spinning on its hind legs, arms out, swirl lines, music notes. Background: disco purple. Colors: gray, black, purple, yellow.

cards.name: Pull-Up Capybara
cards.caption: Ok I pull up
cards.flavor: 2023: the internet's chillest animal got a theme song, and it always pulls up.
cards.art: Capybara in tiny sunglasses with an orange balanced on its head, sitting in a tiny red convertible, totally calm. Background: sunny teal. Colors: capybara brown, orange, red, teal.

cards.name: Low Taper Fade
cards.caption: The meme is still massive
cards.flavor: 2024: 'Imagine if he got a low taper fade.' The haircut grew bigger than the joke.
cards.art: Hair-clipper character with a crisp gradient fade haircut on its own top, smug face, sparkles, a barber pole beside it. Background: black-and-white checker floor. Colors: silver, red/white stripes, black, cyan.

cards.name: Bouncy Baby Hippo
cards.caption: Bouncy, wet, sassy
cards.flavor: 2024: a baby pygmy hippo in Thailand bit, bounced and conquered the internet.
cards.art: Tiny shiny pinkish-gray baby pygmy hippo mid-bounce with attitude, mouth open in a tiny chomp, water droplets flying. Background: mint green. Colors: pinkish gray, rose, mint, white.

cards.name: Snack Tax Gull
cards.caption: Fanum tax. Hand it over.
cards.flavor: 2023: any snack in reach gets taxed. The collector is always watching your fries.
cards.art: White seagull in a green accountant's visor and tie snatching a french fry from a red carton, holding a tiny receipt. Background: bright red. Colors: white, green, red, yellow.

cards.name: Aura Farmer
cards.caption: +1000 aura
cards.flavor: 2024–25: you don't earn aura, you farm it. Pose calmly. Let the boat do the rest.
cards.art: Faceless, adult-proportioned dark-navy silhouette in sunglasses standing on the tip of a long wooden boat, one arm swung in a cool wave, glowing golden aura outline. Background: river at sunset. Colors: deep navy, gold glow, orange sky, teal water.

cards.name: Sigma Wolf
cards.caption: Erm, what the sigma?
cards.flavor: 2023–24: the lone-wolf 'sigma' grindset, turned into Gen Alpha's favorite word.
cards.art: Gray wolf with an impossibly square jaw, one raised eyebrow, sunglasses pushed down its snout, arms crossed. Background: black-and-white with one red slash. Colors: gray, black, white, red.

cards.name: The Rizzard
cards.caption: Unspoken rizz
cards.flavor: Oxford's 2023 Word of the Year. This lizard has rizz and never says a word.
cards.art: Green lizard in a tiny open-collar shirt, one eyebrow raised, hand on chin, sparkle on its smile, floating hearts. Background: hot pink. Colors: lizard green, pink, gold, white.

cards.name: Ohio Final Boss
cards.caption: Only in Ohio
cards.flavor: 2022–23: anything weird 'only happens in Ohio.' Its final boss is weirder.
cards.art: Towering chaos creature: a corn-cob body with a red cardinal-bird head, three mismatched googly eyes, a tiny traffic-cone hat, glowing purple aura. Background: ominous gray cornfield. Colors: corn yellow, cardinal red, purple, gray.
